how: Chrome (headless, Playwright) against the running Vite dev server; values are getBoundingClientRect() in CSS pixels.
notes: Before the fix the spatial navigation was a full-width row of pill tabs; the band that replaced it is 30% of a desktop viewport and 96% of a phone's.
A ring of destinations around a category put one orb at y=795 in a 768px viewport (off the bottom), which is why the desktop destinations fan upwards.
On a 390px phone the same fan covered four category orbs and clipped the band's top, so compact screens place the destinations in the ring's own slots instead.
